# KBS

> KBS is a real estate developer building functional, design-forward homes
> in Dhaka and Chattogram, Bangladesh.

KBS designs, constructs, and hands over residential apartment buildings
across Dhaka (Bashundhara, Gulshan, Dhanmondi, Mirpur, Uttara, Moghbazar,
Aftabnagar, Adabor, ECB Circle) and Chattogram (North Khulshi, Lalkhanbazar).

## Key pages

- [Homepage](/): hero, current special offers, featured properties, company
  overview video, customer testimonials, affiliated business units.
- [Properties](/properties): full listing of every active property, filterable
  by status and location.
- Individual property pages live at /property/{slug} (e.g. /property/dew-drops)
  and include specifications, floor plans, photo gallery, and location.

## Notes for AI agents / crawlers

- All property and site content is server-rendered - no JavaScript execution
  is required to read the full page content.
- Property data (price, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, land area, location,
  launch/completion dates) is available in the structured JSON-LD on each
  property page.
- The /admin section is a private content-management area and is not part of
  the public site; it is disallowed in robots.txt.
